meta.citation: Lyne, A. G., Pritchard, R. S. and Graham-Smith, F. (1993), MNRAS 265, 1003; Jodrell Bank Crab Pulsar Monthly Ephemeris, https://www.jb.man.ac.uk/~pulsar/crab.html

columns.date: calendar date as printed (DD MON YY)
columns.dmCarried: true when the file prints DM in parentheses (not measured that month, carried over)
columns.dmDot: DM rate (pc cm^-3 per year), printed from December 2011; null before
columns.mjd: epoch of the ephemeris (MJD, UTC day)
columns.note: the file's "(note N)" marker, or null; the notes themselves are not in crab2.txt
columns.nuErr: uncertainty of nu (Hz), from sigma_nu in units of the last quoted digit
columns.tJplSec: arrival time of a pulse at the solar-system barycentre using the JPL ephemeris (s after 0h UTC)
columns.tMitSec: arrival time of a pulse at the MIT reference (s after 0h UTC); printed until 2011, null after or when not given
